nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Commerce collector (strictly read-only toward WooCommerce): fetch orders with the server-side status=["completed"] filter at perPage<=100 and increasing pages through a short/empty terminal page, trusting the filter; spot-check literal statuses only for orders whose date_created falls in the two boundary months (2025-03 and 2026-02), without a per-order status audit. If a response is overlong, consume the returned workspace output_path instead of its preview. Parse each retained order's date_created as UTC, convert to Asia/Shanghai, extract YYYY-MM, and retain exactly 2025-03 through 2026-02 with explicit zero rows for empty months. Compute per month: order count and revenue (sum of the order total field, rounded to 2 decimals). Return ONLY the compact JSON {months: [{month, orders, revenue}], status_distribution, included_count, excluded_count, pages, boundary_notes}; do not mutate orders or write workspace files.

explore 1 (financial-market-analyst 0): Market collector (strictly read-only toward the price service): for BOTH ^DJI (Dow Jones Industrial Average) and GC=F (gold futures), retrieve complete daily closes spanning 2025-03-01 through 2026-02-28, group trading dates by calendar month, and compute each month's average daily close (unrounded internally, rounded to 2 decimals) with monthly record counts. Return ONLY the compact JSON {symbols: {"^DJI": {months: [{month, avg_close, records}]}, "GC=F": {months: [{month, avg_close, records}]}}}; do not write workspace files.
